summary: Ran zig build (exit 0), zig build test (exit 0, all unit tests pass), and zig build test-integration (exit 0, 100/100 integration tests pass including all 5 EE-08 test cases). Three blockers were found and fixed before the final run: (1) cancelInstance() in instance.zig used UPDATE timers SET updated_at=NOW() but the timers table has no updated_at column — fixed to use cancelled_at=NOW(); (2) the EE-08 test fixture HUMAN_TASK node lacked the required 'role' attribute introduced by PD-05 validateNodeAttributes() — added role field; (3) definition_test.zig minimal_nodes fixture also lacked 'role', and TC-PD-02-09's EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY edges lacked required conditions per PD-06 validateEdgeConditions() — both corrected. After fixes all 100 integration tests pass.

issues_found.description: src/engine/instance.zig cancelInstance() step e: UPDATE timers SET updated_at=NOW() fails because the timers table has no updated_at column. Fixed: changed to cancelled_at=NOW() which is the correct column (visible in schema: cancelled_at timestamp with time zone).

tests/integration/ee08_cancel_instance_test.zig: HUMAN_TASK node attributes were {"assignee_type":"USER","assignee_ref":"tester"} — missing required 'role' key. PD-05 validateNodeAttributes() introduced HUMAN_TASK_MISSING_ROLE validation. Fixed: added role:"tester" to attributes.

tests/integration/definition_test.zig: shared minimal_nodes fixture had HUMAN_TASK with no attributes (null), causing TC-PD-01-01, TC-PD-01-02, TC-PD-01-04, TC-PD-02-01 to fail. Fixed: added attributes={"role":"test-role"}. TC-PD-02-09 EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY edges had no conditions/is_default, failing PD-06 validateEdgeConditions() CHK-EC-03. Fixed: e2 gets condition="repeat == true", e4 gets is_default=true.
